prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE finished portrait illustration of a Reverse Call SSS Limited mercenary, original art preview, no card UI.
Primary request: Use the supplied white-and-gold male knight's armor and ornate sword as the design reference, but make the body and armor SLIGHTLY slimmer and more elegantly fitted. Preserve the formidable, powerful knight identity.
Input image roles:
1. PRIMARY DESIGN REFERENCE: the silver-haired adult male in white/silver angular plate armor, black undersuit, gold trim, white flowing cape and ornate black/silver/gold sword. Closely retain this recognizable equipment design language, angular shoulder fins, pointed layered chest and thigh plates, and sword's dark central core and gold thornlike flanges. Do not reproduce the reference's gray studio background or watermark.
2. RENDERING/QUALITY REFERENCE ONLY: the blue ice-sovereign illustration. Use its consistent refined 2D anime/painterly treatment, rich atmospheric depth, magnificent limited-rarity lighting and controlled luminous detail. Do NOT copy the woman, her face, hair, costume, pose, ice giant or blue palette.

Subject: A handsome adult male platinum knight, natural short silver-white hair, sharp composed eyes and quiet overwhelming confidence. Athletic with long balanced legs and a defined waist, only about 10–15 percent less bulk than the primary reference; powerful, not frail. The shoulder armor, chest, arms, thighs and greaves fit the body more closely while retaining their angular white/silver and gold plate structure. No enormous swollen pauldrons. Black articulated undersuit shows at functional joints. White cape with dark charcoal lining billows naturally behind him, premium cloth folds and gold edge details.
Weapon: One single ornate straight longsword matching the first reference's distinctive black core, silver cutting edges, angular gold guard and thornlike gold ornamentation. Held naturally in his right armored hand at his side, blade directed diagonally downward, entirely within the image. Pommel, grip, guard, blade root and blade centerline form one coherent straight rigid structure, with symmetrical consistent taper and perspective. No kink at the hand/guard, no curved or broken blade, no excessive blade length. A convincing thumb and fingers close around the handle, wrist anatomically connected; second arm rests naturally.
Composition: Vertical 2:3, complete head-to-toe full-body character and entire sword visible with breathing room around hair, cape, boots and sword tip. Strong readable silhouette. Elegant upright three-quarter standing stance, feet around shoulder-width and one foot subtly forward, relaxed straight torso, no wide squat or exaggerated action lunge. Character dominant in frame; restrained slightly low camera, believable proportions, no foreshortened legs.
Scene and light: A dark, grand ruined stone sanctuary with deep atmospheric architectural silhouettes. A magnificent platinum-white and soft gold aura rises behind the knight with fine suspended sparks, graceful light trails and a subtle radiant circular corona. Enough dark negative space separates the bright armor from the background. Controlled warm metallic edge light and a faint cool silver fill reveal every armor plane. Powerful jewel-like eyes, not laser beams. SSS Limited collectible RPG splash-art polish, intricate purposeful armor detail, dramatic depth; aura must not cover face, hands, weapon silhouette or feet.
Style/medium: A SINGLE consistent premium 2D anime illustration with delicate painterly shading throughout. Face, neck, hands, hair, armor and cape share one line and shadow language. Mature male facial proportions, not doll-like. No photoreal face, pasted-in face, 3D render or live-action skin texture. Hair flows naturally from roots to tips in fine continuous strands with organic volume and restrained highlights; no rigid layered slabs, thick spikes like blades or plastic shine.
No words, letters, numbers, name, logo, artist signature, watermark, card frame, badges or UI. One character only, no extra weapons, no dragons or giant figure. Deliver a finished full-color illustration, not a sheet, collage or mockup.

referenceRoles.role: User-supplied armor and sword design reference
Drawing style / lighting and atmospheric depth only
